evidence.evidence: Public Shell Auditor execution 73575 audited 34 canonical pages with 0 violations.
scripts/validate_static_site.py requires exact Services, Assessments, Results, Products, Insights, About navigation and the Start an Assessment header CTA on every canonical sitemap page.

public/assets/css/growth-os.css defines neutral black/gray surfaces (#0d0d0d, #171717, #1a1a1a) with orange accent #f97316 / #ea580c and white/neutral text; no navy canonical palette token is defined.

Canonical shell uses Sora for display/brand, Inter for body UI, JetBrains Mono for technical labels; shared buttons, cards, forms, focus states and responsive breakpoints are centralized in growth-os.css.
The permanent static validator scans all public HTML, not only sitemap pages, for Stage 4 blocked unsupported claims and current Forgejo Actions are green.
Stage 9 policy and baseline preserve the exact Tayoca Operator Brief identity and fixed eight-section editorial contract.
Stage 10 certified one product ecosystem with four families, 16 products and eight commercial controls rather than unrelated microsites.

accepted_findings.finding: Legacy/non-canonical HTML files may not use the full current shell.
accepted_findings.disposition: They are not canonical sitemap surfaces. The permanent blocked-claim scan still covers every public HTML file, and canonical brand certification is defined by the 34 validated sitemap pages.
